visualCharacteristics.purpose: cards-feature — grid of borderless feature cards, each a landscape image above a heading, short description and arrow call-to-action link; the whole card is clickable via that link
visualCharacteristics.structure: 3-column grid on desktop (2 at tablet, stacked on mobile); full-width 16:9 image on top of each card; text link with circled arrow icon

contentPattern.structure: 2 cells — cell 1: image (landscape picture); cell 2: rich text with an h3 heading, a description paragraph, and a paragraph containing one link (the card's call to action; its text is the link label)
